name: Mikadozaki Kaede
source: [url=/c27534]Yuriko's[/url] close friend who is part of the Lacrosse Club. She has a strong personality, but can't stand ghost stories or scary stuff in general. Kaede treasures Yuriko so much that she won't let anybody even think about having her as their girlfriend.
